about: I study Game Design & Development at Macromedia University in Cologne. Before that I trained as an IT specialist for systems integration (Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration) and worked in IT support.

That background still shows in how I make games. I like the technical side the most: gameplay systems, tools and getting assets cleanly from Blender into the engine. Next to my studies I work as a working student in Enterprise Architecture Management at CONET.
I'm happiest when code, art and design come together and a game just plays well. That's what I want to keep working on, ideally in a team where technical and creative people work closely together.
